notIdeasOfWhatSocietyShouldBe.explanation: Red fascism is a concept, used by critics from Fabbri, Rizzi and Borkenau to Cold War anti-communists, that equates Stalinism and other Marxism-Leninism with fascism; no movement states it as its own programme. I went through the statements against the article and its cited uses (anarchist, council-communist, social-democratic and US anti-communist accusations): the positions they argue against (one-party rule, state terror, nationalisation) are Marxism-Leninism's, a separate ideology, and the one convergence it names, red-brownism, is another subject, so fewer than two statements can be answered from sources about red fascism itself.
